simple.meaning: בֵּצַי (Bêtsay) is a Hebrew word meaning “Betsai , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֵּצַי (H1209) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:17, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֵּצַי (H1209) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֵּצַי (H1209) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֵּצַי (Bêtsay) / H1209 is traced through Ezra 2:17, Nehemiah 7:23, Nehemiah 10:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
